description: A darker, more realistic night with procedural street lighting. Lifts the near-black night floor, boosts city window / vehicle / beacon lights, and lines the road network with low-poly cobra-head street lamps (glowing lens + real ground-light pools drawn by a custom URP pass). Lamp poles are physically knocked down by explosion shockwaves. Fully client-side and multiplayer-safe; every effect reverts when the mod is disabled.
